title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00382069832557 from one fewer P104 batch boundary
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Conditional κ ≥ 0.00382069832557**, a strict increase of **0.00000006054380** over the directed upper endpoint 0.00382063778177 for Ali Romman’s #7756 construction. The new raw crossing is [0.00382069832565, 0.00382069832566]. Both sides use the same graph, 2,048 native invocations and the same five assumptions. [Proof](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/PROOF.md) · [Complete signed invoices](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/evidence/price.json)

Closing two independent 1,024-call batches requires sixteen homogeneous B roots. A single chronological batch needs eight. It replaces 56 homogeneous A roots and eight B roots with 64 mixed roots. Paid jobs fall from 12,161,984 to 12,161,504 and productive targets from 2,185,728 to 2,185,472. Pricing both sides gives a net credit of `224 × (1 + 8^(1−κ) − 9^(1−κ))`. Ordinary map slots rise from 67,877,696 to 68,126,112 and scalar services from 52,366,581,760 to 52,630,409,216. The compiler covers the larger ordinary bill. [Physical and compiler application](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/evidence/application.json)

## Task and overlap

Scope refined within `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 8. The edit changes the caller boundary on the literal #7756 word. Ali Romman supplied the native graph, mixed root and parametric placement. This contribution instantiates and certifies the 2,048-call word, compares equal call counts, and proves a first-call lower bound of eight homogeneous B roots. Under the three tested templates, full occupancy, distinct owners and sixteen colors, the bound gives a limiting raw crossing below 0.00382075887147. #7758 audits two helper observations and #7759 audits the head and view charges of one mixed root. [Task card](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/TASK.json) · [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19721689)

Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The predecessor is pinned at public head `6b0044123aad114cf71ca2bb0e98741e5a27c7b5` and scientific commit `9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417`. Scientific commit `d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07` contains the new package. Its parent `0eabc624a9bc9ed2847719efd63390db4d297df4` is the existing #7257 CI repair for the selected-family replay. [Source manifest](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/PR7756-SOURCES.json)

## Validation

Reproduce all five registered checks with CPython 3.12 and the standard library from the repository root.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary
```

Two reconstructions matched all 35,717,248 emitted caller records, SHA-256 `3b326189234984d7797566fa4732d4e2698db778f117cd09bb5654ea740c5563`. The signed identities, disjoint owners, physical restoration and charged views establish the arbitrary-input application. Two finite character executions also checked all 420,096 final owners. A separate reviewer reproduced the prices, compiler, expansion and probes at the frozen scientific commit. Deliberately corrupted controls were rejected. [Independent schedule](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/evidence/seam.json) · [Owner projection](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/evidence/expansion.json) · [Character executions](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/evidence/probe.json) · [Native replay](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/evidence/native-source-replay.json)

The five inherited premises are native application at every positive column multiplicity, owned erasure, uniform mixed-target compilation, precision and tape accounting, and analytic recovery. A materialized general multiplier, independent human proof and formal-kernel acceptance remain open. Canonical main selects #7000 at 0.00363005817.

Clear1nsight contributed prior causal splits and guarded physical accounting. Clear1nsight prepared this extension with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Original source notices are retained. [Lineage and notices](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/README.md#credit)

## Open next questions

**Request for maintainer frontier review.** Please compare both boundary invoices at equal call count, replay the two owner-stream reconstructions, and assess the increased ordinary cost under the five premises. A route beyond the three-template ceiling needs a fourth signed root with legal port order and an explicitly priced replacement.
